<MethodEndpoint
  method={"get"}
  path={"/api/instance_git_log"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Returns the commit history of the instance repo at WORKING_DIR -
every tracked change to settings/, users/, and the rest of what the
instance repo covers (see GITutils.INSTANCE_GITIGNORE for what's
excluded). Mirrors the project popout's Git History tab, but for the
instance itself rather than a project's hub.
